name: Wei Jian Tan
bio:
Wei Jian's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karts at a local track. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the National University of Singapore, focusing on materials science and manufacturing processes. Upon graduation, he joined a local engineering firm before transitioning to motorsport. He's known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to troubleshoot complex fabrication issues quickly.

Wei Jian believes in a collaborative approach to problem-solving, often seeking input from engineers and mechanics alike. He is particularly skilled in welding and composite layup, consistently delivering high-quality components that meet demanding performance requirements. His ambition is to lead a fabrication team and contribute to the development of cutting-edge racing technologies.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Wei Jian is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool with him.
Listens to Mandopop while working, but only through headphones.
Meticulously cleans his workspace at the end of each day.
